name: +1 Speed Hospital Escape
desc:
Welcome To +1 Speed Hospital Escape

❓ HOW TO PLAY: ❓
🏥 You're trapped in the world's craziest hospital, can you escape?
🏃‍♀️ Run through crazy corridors, dodge wild doctors and nurses, and survive twisted medical tests!
💰 Earn cash by reaching checkpoints and escaping each floor!
📊 Upgrade your speed, stamina, and skills to outsmart the hospital’s traps!

⚡ Get faster and sharper with every run and master the art of escaping the madness!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and prove you're the #1 hospital escape artist!
🎮 Can you ESCAPE every level of this medical mayhem?

👍 Like & Favorite the game to support more epic escape adventures!
🔔 Join our group for exclusive rewards and the latest game news!
